info.syllabusName: Quản trị nguồn nhân lực (Human Resource Management)
info.description:
In brief, the course strives to equip students with the necessary tools (i.e. conceptual frameworks and theories) to understand and appreciate the importance of HRM as part of the process of creating a successful organization. On a higher level, this course aims to help students increase their knowledge of HRM as a fundamental component of the competitiveness, effectiveness, and sustainability of any organization. 
Ultimately, the goal of the course is to show that HR management is significantly more than just accepting employment applications and keeping records; it is a strategic part of every organization and it is probably the first place and the last place where organizational problems begin to form.
Chapter 1: Introduction to Human resource management
Chapter 2: Human resource planning
Chapter 3: Job analysis
Chapter 4: Recruitment process
Chapter 5: Tests, multiple-choice and interview
Chapter 6: Career orientation/ development
Chapter 7: Training and development
Chapter 8: Managing performance appraisals
Chapter 9: Compensation and benefits
Chapter 10: Labor relations
Chapter 11: International human resource management
Chapter 12: Evaluation of the performance of human resource management activities
